opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order.
opening.opening_summary: A Protoss opening that emphasizes heavy technology investment and economic expansion while keeping production moderate in the early game. The plan is to develop a strong tech-based army and economy, then transition into a heavier production and ground-oriented composition as the game progresses.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a technology / economy / expansion posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
